text.text_excerpt: Located on the very popular Freret Street, Publiq House is an interesting place. I first learned of Publiq House from fellow Yelpers. While I really like the Freret area, I always seem to focus my nights out in other areas. Freret has become significantly more upscale since my days of hanging at the Sitting Duck, and Publiq House fits that new mold very well. One one visit I spoke with the owner/manager and he told me that the space was once a neighborhood grocery store. From the looks of it I had assumed it was an old theater, but either way, it has a cool old vibe while being completely modern inside. I have yet to see a show there, but the stage area looked nice. I went to Publiq House for the first time on Thursday night. They've got a good beer selection, some pretty solid mixed drinks, daiquiris, and some pretty awesome drinks made with both liquor and beer. The Brass-A-Holics were playing, which was definitely a bonus. Even with the band playing at full volume, you can still hold a conversation here. I'd say it's a good spot to come for a fun date night or to come with friends. I'll definitely be checking out Publiq House again.

I have to say, that I have been here twice, and I am already a fan of Publiq house. Located on Freret St., Publiq house is a brand new bar/music venue. When you first walk in, you are greeted by a long bar with a lot of drink selections. They have a few beers on tap and they also have a huge selection of bottles beers. They have a menu you can look at and decide what you want. They also have a fancy cocktail menu. All of the drinks are served very uniquely in different types of jars. It sounds odd, but it's actually really cool. Throughout the entire place there are tables that seat about 5-6 people each. There is also a huge stage for music performances.
